title: Resolve Nostr worker read-model kind collisions
observed_behavior: Worker read-model kinds reused public system discovery and backup registry event kinds: KindWorkerState used 31974, which is also KindSystemDiscovery, and worker assignment/drain/eligibility used 31991-31993, which are backup registry kinds. The requested 31994-31997 target block was also occupied by backup read models.
intended_behavior: System discovery remains on 31974, backup read models remain on 31991-31999, and worker read models publish only a non-colliding contiguous kind block. Mixed-version consumers can recognize the prior worker read-model kind values during one release window without new publisher paths emitting them.
